note: Campground at Rocky Mountain House National Historic Site by the North Saskatchewan River: an unserviced trailer campground and walk-in tent sites, plus tipis, Métis trapper tents and trapline cabins. Generators 9-11 am and 6-8 pm only. No Wi-Fi. --Claude
summary: Confirmed federal, unserviced, rigs to 27 ft, reservable, 14-night max; C$31.75 a night plus the NHS entry fee (C$10 an adult a day); 2027 season May 14 - Sep 30 from the office hours.
